content:
“Just a little at a time keeps the thirst away.”

**Hydro Fix** is an Endurance-based perk in *Fallout 76*.

It is exclusive to human players and cannot be equipped by ghoul players.

Chems restore thirst.

| Rank | Cost | Description | Form ID | 
| ★★ | 2 | Chems restore twice as much thirst. | 001872F4 | 
| ★ | 1 | Chems restore thirst. | 00122C56 | 

- Before update 60, the perk had 2 ranks that reduced thirst generation by 50%/100%.

- Munchy Resistance - similar perk for hunger
